integrity: Infinite-family statements have a self-contained symbolic proof. Independently reproducible finite checks were executed for d=3 and d=4. No independent external scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is for integers d≥3 with shortest-path graph distance on vertex–facet incidence graphs, not Euclidean distance or Hamming-only hypercube vertices; no equivariant classification is claimed. Equivalent unindexed prior results remain possible.
title: Complete Vietoris–Rips homotopy filtration of cubical vertex–facet incidence graphs
